alt: 醫護人員專心照護病床上手臂包紮的孩子，醫生抬手婉拒旁人遞來的金幣，前方的沙漏持續流下細沙。
scene_prompt: Inside a simple modern emergency treatment room, a focused doctor and nurse use their brief available time to provide urgent care to a small injured child resting safely on a bed, fully clothed with only a simple arm bandage. A small hourglass with just a few grains remaining sits prominently beside the treatment supplies; a wealthy visitor offers a pouch spilling gold coins, but the doctor gently gestures the money aside and concentrates entirely on helping the child immediately. Show the irreplaceable value of a moment through lifesaving attention; no blood, no frightening machinery, no readable writing or clock numerals.
